name: Glitch Prison
source:
A simple and short story that took place in virtual reality. 

The main character gets into a glitch and tries to get out of it, but, as 
it turned out, he was not alone there.

[From [url=https://yggdralogy.itch.io/glitch-prison]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个发生在虚拟现实中的简单而短小的故事。

主角陷入困境并试图摆脱困境，但是，
事实证明，他并不孤单。

[来自[url=https://yggdralogy.itch.io/glitch-prison]itch.io[/url]]
